# Erase: EL, ED, ECH. Each case starts from DECALN (a screen of E).

=== DECALN fills the screen and homes the cursor
source: esctest2 decaln.py test_DECALN_FillsScreen, test_DECALN_MovesCursorHome
input: \e[3;3H\e#8
cursor: 1,1
screen:
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|

=== EL 0 erases from the cursor to the end of the line
source: esctest2 el.py test_EL_0
input: \e#8\e[1;4H\e[K
cursor: 1,4
screen:
|EEE.......|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|

=== EL 1 erases from the start of the line through the cursor
source: esctest2 el.py test_EL_1
input: \e#8\e[1;4H\e[1K
cursor: 1,4
screen:
|....EEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|

=== EL 2 erases the whole line
source: esctest2 el.py test_EL_2
input: \e#8\e[3;4H\e[2K
cursor: 3,4
screen:
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|..........|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|

=== EL ignores the scroll region
source: esctest2 el.py test_EL_IgnoresScrollRegion
input: \e#8\e[2;3r\e[5;4H\e[K
screen:
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEE.......|

=== EL with an unknown parameter does nothing
source: xterm ctlseqs EL (Ps 0, 1, 2 only)
input: \e#8\e[1;4H\e[9K
screen:
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|

=== EL in the pending wrap erases the last column and clears the wrap
source: xterm ctlseqs DECAWM; vttest menu 1
input: 0123456789\e[K
cursor: 1,10
screen:
|012345678.|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== ED 0 erases from the cursor to the end of the screen
source: esctest2 ed.py test_ED_0, test_ED_Default
input: \e#8\e[2;4H\e[J
cursor: 2,4
screen:
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEE.......|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== ED 1 erases from the start of the screen through the cursor
source: esctest2 ed.py test_ED_1
input: \e#8\e[2;4H\e[1J
cursor: 2,4
screen:
|..........|
|....EEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|

=== ED 2 erases the screen without moving the cursor
source: esctest2 ed.py test_ED_2
input: \e#8\e[2;4H\e[2J
cursor: 2,4
screen:
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== ED ignores the scroll region
source: esctest2 ed.py test_ED_0_WithScrollRegion
input: \e#8\e[2;3r\e[2;4H\e[J
screen:
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEE.......|
|..........|
|..........|
|..........|

=== ED 3 clears the scrollback and leaves the screen
source: esctest2 ed.py test_ED_3; xterm ctlseqs ED Ps = 3
size: 10x2
scrollback: 5
input: a\r\nb\r\nc\e[3J
history: 0
screen:
|b.........|
|c.........|

=== ECH erases cells without moving the rest
source: esctest2 ech.py test_ECH_ExplicitParam
input: \e#8\e[1;3H\e[4X
cursor: 1,3
screen:
|EE....EEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|

=== ECH defaults to one cell
source: esctest2 ech.py test_ECH_DefaultParam
input: \e#8\e[1;3H\e[X
screen:
|EE.EEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|

=== ECH stops at the end of the line
source: esctest2 ech.py test_ECH_IgnoresScrollRegion
input: \e#8\e[1;8H\e[99X
screen:
|EEEEEEE...|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|
|EEEEEEEEEE|

=== Erased cells keep the pen background only
source: xterm ctlseqs, background colour erase (BCE)
input: \e[1;41m\e[2K\e[m
cursor: 1,1
style: 1,1 bg=1
style: 1,10 bg=1
style: 2,1 default
